74: But [he who says omein] in "who builds Yerusholayim" - which is at the end of the blessings, then it is praiseworthy and so to at the end of the blessings of the recition of the shema, Shacharis and Ma'ariv. And that that the Borayso taught that [to say omein] after all his blessings is praiseworthy, it means to say: After all his blessings. And that that it taught that [to say omein] after all his blessings is derogatory, it means to say that [to say omein] after each blessings individually [is derogatory].
